budgets.accounting: cgroup-v2 parent containing Tika/gateway, optional OCR sidecar, and load generator; all descendants included
budgets.memory_policy: Every Tika/OCR container leaf has the same 3 GiB ceiling and zero swap; the shared 3 GiB parent is binding. No separate 1 GiB Tesseract ceiling.
budgets.memory_interpretation: Parent memory.current and memory.peak are charged memory, not a sum of process RSS. Model file cache populated before the run may remain charged to the acquisition cgroup. The parent peak includes startup; usage delta spans warmup and the measured cohort.

execution.order: same seeded per-repetition Fisher-Yates order for every variant; arm order fixed by seed, recorded; budgets not pooled
execution.partial_runs: retained with missing/failed cases; no repaired first-attempt quality; incomplete runs not paired
execution.java_watchdog: Xms32m Xmx128m ActiveProcessorCount=1 UseSerialGC; identical all arms
execution.java_parser: Xms64m Xmx512m ActiveProcessorCount=1 UseSerialGC; identical all arms
execution.generic_native_thread_environment: OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL use cpu_budget for Python and native Indra; Tesseract OMP=1. ONNX and OpenCV explicit threads use cpu_budget.
execution.startup_scope: Process and model initialization after model-inventory hashing has warmed the host file cache; measured separately from HTTP requests. This is not storage-cold startup.
execution.probe_policy: Docker image healthchecks disabled in every arm. The optional gateway OCR dependency is disabled in every benchmark arm; the controller explicitly verifies both services before measuring.
execution.cgroup_lifetime: A newly created unique parent slice per arm and CPU budget. Never reuse an empty slice: memory.peak is a cgroup lifetime high-water mark.
execution.ocr_deadlines: Common Tika OCR subprocess timeout60s in both frozen XML files; Indra internal request deadlines65s, bridge70s, gateway300s, external load generator120s. The common Tika timeout bounds the OCR subprocess in every arm; late internal work stays accounted until cleanup.

metrics.primary: NFC Unicode-scalar Levenshtein CER preserving whitespace/punctuation
secondary: WER only where whitespace tokenization is declared
successful pages per measured closed-loop wall second
successful complete-body latency p50/p95/p99 across all repetitions with full finite-sample counts; failed-attempt termination times reported separately
parent CPU time and charged-memory counters
metrics.comparison: paired document-cluster resampling on joint first-attempt successes; excluded failures separately enumerated
metrics.small_strata: no interval with fewer than two document clusters; challenge results never pooled with primary; no multiplicity-adjusted superiority claim

optimization_ablations.design: one-factor comparisons against b64/spinning=true; same pinned fixtures, 1/2CPU, no quality-based case selection
actual synthetic 64-line decoder batch-shape and exact-output equivalence gate; implementation evidence, not 64 independent accuracy samples
same 1/2CPU cases with raw samples; select only after end-to-end effect exceeds noise and output is unchanged
fixed bounded load with real local OTLP/Sentry sinks; record export/drop counters and latency

limitations: Stratified diagnostic sample, not a probability sample of production documents.
Thirty-three primary pages contain only nineteen source-document clusters.
Historical editorial supplied text is not visible-glyph gold.
Modern lab reports and contemporary scientific manuscripts are not admitted; historical BHL biology does not fill that gap.
Training-set overlap unknown; implementation-exposed sources remain disclosed.
Tesseract receives frozen language hints; Indra uses its native script selection.
Math-enabled output can improve formulas while harming ordinary text or adding LaTeX formatting; no blanket highest-accuracy claim.
Cross-request continuous decoder batching is not implemented in the initial engine and must not be described as tested.
Signed synthetic baseline has different corpus, concurrency and driver scope; never pool its throughput or quality with this study.
